resources.string: No results ship with this app

This harness measures the device you are holding, right now, and writes the result to a file you can share. Nothing is uploaded, and no measurement is bundled with the app.\n\nThe project has no ARM test device, so no number here has ever been checked against real hardware by its authors. Continuous integration runs this on an x86_64 emulator, which is useful only for spotting that something changed between two builds — it is not a phone.

Prompt processing and token generation rates, measured separately. Cold and warm model load time. Time to first token. Peak memory, read from the kernel\'s own high-water mark. Energy per token, where the battery exposes a counter. Thermal state before and after every repetition.
On-device inference is not available in this build, so a run will complete but will not measure inference. The result file records this.
No GGUF models found on this device. Download one first.
